Name: }bedrock.data.load.cube

Parameters.Name: pDatasource
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Data source specification. If a string is passed, it will be assumed to be a cube name. If no cube exists, it will be assumed to be a CSV file. To be more detailed, pass a JSON Object with the data source variable name as the key, and the value as the value. E.g. {"datasourcenameforserver":"file.csv", "datasourceasciiheaderrecords":3}

Parameters.Name: pTargetCube
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Target cube name

Parameters.Name: pFilter
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Array or JSON Object specifying which elements to include in the view (JSON Array or JSON Object. Default = '{}')

Parameters.Name: pExcept
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Array or JSON Object specifying which elements to exclude in the view (JSON Array or JSON Object. Default = '{}')

Parameters.Name: pDimMap
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Required if target has dims not in source. Format: 'dim_one¦ el_one & dim_two¦ el_two'

Parameters.Name: pMultithreadDimensions
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Parallelization filter in format: dim_one¦ el_one + el_two. Dimension must not be part of filter

Parameters.Name: pMaxThreads
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Maximum number of threads to run when parallel processing is enabled (Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pSuppressConsol
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Suppress consolidated values (Boolean. Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pSuppressConsolStrings
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Suppress consolidated string cells (Boolean. Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pSuppressRules
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Suppress rules (Boolean. Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pSuppressZero
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Suppress zeroes (Boolean. Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pZeroTarget
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Zero out target before start of process (Boolean. Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pFactor
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Multiply source values by factor (Default = 1)

Parameters.Name: pTemp
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Delete/create temporary objects (0 = Do not delete, 1 = Delete, 2 = if view and subsets are created, keep only subsets)

Parameters.Name: pSandbox
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Use sandbox

Parameters.Name: pDecimalSeparator
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Decimal separator for string/number conversion (Exactly 3 digits = ASCII code. Default ='.')

Parameters.Name: pThousandSeparator
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Thousand separator for string/number conversion (Exactly 3 digits = ASCII code. Default = ',')

Parameters.Name: pMappingOverride
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Override any mapping that has been created by this process

Parameters.Name: pIncrement
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Increment amounts (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
